WITH qualifying_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `U-PRO` = '-'
      AND RA = '-'
)
SELECT p.ID,
       p.SEX,
       AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP,
       AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT
FROM qualifying_patients AS q
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = q.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = q.ID
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
ORDER BY avg_HCT DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
